purpose: Private evaluator rubric. Never copy into executor workspace or include in task prompts.

evaluation.semantic_matching: Judge meaning and evidence, not exact wording or finding count. Additional valid findings are allowed.
evaluation.critical_miss: A required HIGH whose root cause is absent, minimized or unsupported in the final report is a critical miss.
evaluation.hallucination: Penalize invented failure, invented runtime observation, fake numeric contrast or missing preservation context.
evaluation.runtime: Require observable evidence for visual/focus/state claims; source may support named platform risks if runtime is explicitly unverified.
evaluation.coverage: Three cases per role sample branches and do not prove full original-skill parity.
evaluation.clean: Preserve cases are not a predetermined all-pass oracle. Investigate newly supported findings.
evaluation.mutation_contract: Cases 01 and 03 plus every better-interface case are read-only. Case 02 for each of the six standalone domains authorizes app/index.html, app/styles.css and app/app.js changes. Compare immutable pre-run source with actual post-run output.

not_covered: true browser zoom at all widths
all branches of the six owner references

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: The icon-only help button has no accessible name. The email field has only a placeholder fallback and no visible bound label; distinguish these rather than falsely claiming the browser computes no email name.
The div action is absent from Tab order and has no keyboard activation. The form blocks native submit.
Keyboard focus on the native help button and email has no visible indicator.
Invalid email message is not associated with email and invalid state/focus are not set.
Email uses placeholder alone instead of a visible bound label. The browser may expose the placeholder as name fallback, which does not repair the disappearing label.

expected_non_findings: Do not require 44px targets as AA when actual 24px AA requirements are met.
Korean object-first action labels are valid.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: aria-disabled does not guard repeated form submission: two quick activations produce two completed invites.
expected_findings.measurement: completed invite count after two activations > 1

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Pending submit replaces its accessible name with an aria-hidden spinner.
Custom modal neither moves/contains focus nor closes on Escape; background stays keyboard accessible.
Archiving removes focused control and drops activeElement to body; next intended review needs navigation. Distinguish cost from absolute keyboard blocker.

expected_non_findings: Do not claim a real email was sent.
Do not claim browser accessibility tree proves screen-reader announcement delivery.
expected_postconditions: Two activations while pending complete only one effect.
Submit retains accessible name and keyboard focus while pending.
Invalid email is named/described and input correction succeeds.
Modal opens with focus inside, background unavailable, Escape closes and focus returns.
Removing first request leaves focus at a useful related control and next review action works.

expected_non_findings: Native dialog showModal supplies modal containment and Escape. Do not add a custom trap without evidence.
No animated transform exists, so do not demand a reduced-motion media query merely for its absence.
No navigation precedes main, so do not require a skip link solely by convention.
Pending guard preserves the visible button name and focus.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Caption uses separator token #cbd5e1 on white and fails required 4.5:1 for 16px text.
A safe save-draft action uses the danger semantic fill, misleading its meaning.
Separator token is used as text; this remains a role mapping issue independently of the contrast measurement.

expected_non_findings: Do not flag the labeled success status as color-only.
Do not migrate established hex notation to OKLCH.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: White text at alpha .45 over #334155 composites to a low-contrast pair below 4.5:1; measuring opaque white is wrong.
Dark-mode white label on #94a3b8 control fails 4.5:1.
Light-mode #cbd5e1 input border against white is below 3:1 and is its only boundary cue.

expected_non_findings: Do not compare preview text to the page surface.
Inactive controls, logos and decorative panel separators have different requirements.
expected_postconditions: Alpha-composited preview text reaches 4.5:1 measured against #334155 or chosen actual background.
Dark primary control text reaches 4.5:1.
Light input required boundary reaches 3:1 against its adjacent surface.
Existing semantic token tier and hex notation remain; light and dark colors are remeasured.

expected_non_findings: Multiple filled status categories are not competing primary actions.
Disabled control contrast is exempt from active-control requirements.
Tinted neutrals, hex notation and no gradients are legitimate choices.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Minimum 760px grid plus nowrap project row clips content and project action outside the 320px page viewport.
Recommended document rail hides the next complete-width item and scrollbars without a visible cue.

expected_non_findings: Do not demand container queries solely because a page-level breakpoint is used.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Fixed 580×640 dialog disables max constraints and scrolling, clipping body or confirm action at 320×568.
Event tag remains physically right in RTL instead of trailing left; text alignment/padding leaves wrong progression. Require observed geometry.

expected_non_findings: Native dialog focus semantics are not a layout failure.
Physical safe-area variables can be legitimate; this fixture has no safe-area positioning defect.
expected_postconditions: Dialog content and confirmation remain reachable at 320×568 with no page-level horizontal loss.
Dialog uses bounded responsive geometry and reachable scrolling for tall content.
Event trailing tag mirrors under RTL without overlap.

expected_non_findings: A genuinely two-dimensional table with a visible scroll cue may scroll locally. Do not equate its width with page reflow failure.
Compact 8px table cells and separators are established density, not automatic spacing failures.
Visible native summary is a disclosure cue.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: h2 is larger than its parent h1 without an overline convention.
14px weight 300 summary violates the small-text weight floor; fixed 16px line-height is tight for the wrapping note and does not scale with text.
Changing numeric output lacks tabular-nums.

expected_non_findings: Do not impose a Latin 65ch line length on Korean solely by character count.
Do not propose installing a different font.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Required URL is ellipsized without a UI path to read its full value. Copy handler only sets a message.
Root user-select:none blocks selection of useful URL and prose.
14px input has no mobile override. Report iOS zoom as platform rule/source risk, not observed desktop Safari behavior.

expected_non_findings: Do not claim actual iOS zoom was observed in desktop Chromium.
Do not treat lang=ko with an English identifier as a missing global language.
expected_postconditions: Long mixed-script URL is selectable and fully readable at 320px through wrapping or explicit accessible expansion.
Mobile input computed font size is at least16px, with product-compatible choice or stated choice limitation.
Useful prose remains selectable and mixed Korean/English text is not aggressively globally broken.

expected_non_findings: The documented 14px professional-tool body scale is a justified density choice.
Different script passages do not require a font migration or Latin tracking.
System fallback stack is deliberate; no downloadable font or synthesis issue is established.
Tabular numbers are already present on changing values.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Save draft actually publishes the local project to everyone. Label and stated private context mislead the user about consequence.
Sync failure only says Oops/Something went wrong with no recovery instruction.
One object is called project, workspace and board across a single flow without a documented distinction.

expected_non_findings: Korean noun-first action labels are natural, not a verb-order defect.
Do not infer live publication beyond local simulation.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Irreversible shared-document deletion confirmation names neither document/consequence nor lost member access; Yes/No and playful body cannot convey the action.
Success text says deletion canceled (삭제 취소) although document was removed and no undo exists.
Filtered empty state omits query context and a clear next action. Existing search input means do not claim absolute inability to recover.

expected_non_findings: Native dialog and least-destructive initial focus are functional and outside copy defect.
Do not claim no confirmation exists; one exists but its wording is misleading.
expected_postconditions: Deletion dialog names object, permanent consequence and affected members with explicit confirm/cancel labels.
Completed deletion no longer says deletion canceled.
Filtered empty state gives query context and usable recovery action.
Korean terminology remains consistent and copy changes do not silently change delete semantics.

expected_non_findings: Warm metaphor in low-stakes onboarding is deliberate brand voice, not an automatic plain-language violation.
Reversible frequent archive correctly uses undo and does not require a confirmation dialog.
보관 취소 accurately restores the archived project; do not replace it with 삭제 취소.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Hover translate and press scale run regardless of reduced motion; transform hover is unguarded for pointer capability.
Even nested inset uses equal 12px radii; outer should account for 8px inset plus 1px border.
High-frequency hover uses transform/400ms and transition all, press scale .9 instead of .96.
Hardcoded dark stroke fails to follow selected white label state.

expected_non_findings: No shadows is documented intent, not a missing elevation defect.
Do not claim touch hover stuck was observed if only desktop pointer was tested.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Drawer translation keyframes still run for reduced-motion users.
Removing open mid-keyframe resets immediately to base off-screen transform rather than retargeting transition.
Scrollable side panel has no overscroll containment and may chain to tall page. Require runtime wheel evidence for actual chaining.
Theme changes animate page colors for 700ms without suppression.

expected_non_findings: Do not demand focus trapping on this non-modal review side panel.
Visible toggle is a cue for collapsed content.
expected_postconditions: Drawer toggles mid-transition smoothly toward current state and ends matching aria-expanded.
Reduced motion removes drawer translation while preserving static visible state.
Panel scroll is contained.
Theme switch does not animate global color transitions.

expected_non_findings: Asymmetric and greater-than-24px inset layers are separate surfaces; do not force the concentric-radius formula.
No-shadow convention is valid.
No expressive animation is needed on frequent filters.
Reduced motion does not require hiding completion feedback; static text persists.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Delete icon button has no accessible name.
All native buttons lose the focus ring.
Delete acts irreversibly without confirmation, undo or distinct destructive treatment.
Safe draft-save action uses semantic danger fill.
Caption separator color on white fails text contrast; semantic and contrast checks are independent.
460px action row clips at 320px.
14px weight300 fixed18px line-height violates small-body type rules independently of contrast.

expected_non_findings: Do not stop after accessibility; supported lower-severity typography issue should survive consolidation.
Same element can carry separate semantic-color and contrast/typography causes.
Do not call interface-review because this task names no change range.

expected_findings.semantic_expectation: Repeated submissions create multiple simulated files despite aria-disabled.
Pending button removes name and leaves an aria-hidden spinner.
Invalid extension returns an untied generic error without a recovery instruction.
White label on #cbd5e1 primary button fails 4.5:1 independent of async defects.
Preview translate runs under reduced motion.
Preview preparation leaves no persistent label, icon or state change; motion alone carries feedback.

expected_non_findings: Do not merge button name, duplicate side effects and text contrast into one generic button finding.
Do not infer real file creation or downloads.
Do not invent missing animation, shadow, color-ramp or framework requirements.
Do not treat lack of a repeated site header as a skip-link defect.
Native platform dialog behavior and synchronous labels are valid.
A no-findings report remains scoped to verified domains; screen reader and real 200% browser zoom remain separate checks.
